interface.signature: nthCharacter(S: str, R: int, N: int) -> str

preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 10^3.
The number of iterations R is between 1 and 20.
The index N is within the bounds of the final string length after R iterations.

postconditions.expression: output == S[N] for S after R iterations
postconditions.description: The output is the character at index N of the string after R iterations.
